notes: C16 is marked partly because the referee notes Daphne 7373 inhomogeneity is small at 1.0-1.2 GPa, whereas the review notes solidification at low temperature and criticizes invoking non-hydrostaticity ad hoc for the double dips. C3 is marked partly because the review discusses physical mechanisms for the broad flat-topped 1.4 GPa spectrum (critical current in P29, magnetic fluctuations in P9) rather than requesting a BTK fit. C17 is marked partly because the review critiques the physical justification of the linear superposition model (Eqs. 2-3) without explicitly mentioning interband coupling.
